title: Critique: simple expander circuits have large phi

statements.text: Simple networks of logic gates wired as expander graphs, which do nothing intelligent, can have integrated information far above that of a brain. A theory that must call such circuits highly conscious fails the requirement that phi be small for intuitively unconscious systems.

sources.quote: for the theory to work, it had better be the case that Φ is small for “intuitively unconscious” systems, and only large for “intuitively conscious” systems.
